tbl_description: One row per physical water filter (parentEventID grain, 47 rows): position, depth, collection datetime.
One row per detection (occurrenceID/eventID grain, 201 rows): taxon, sequence-read count, and which of the two molecular assays (D-loop or 12S/MiFish) produced it.

Co-collected water chemistry (ammonia, nitrate, nitrite, phosphate, silicate, chl_fluor, dissolved oxygen) and genomics QC (DNA concentration, raw/filtered read totals, OTU richness) per parentEventID sample -- 11 measurement types out of ~60 source measurementType values that carry an actual value/unit.
